recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a musician standing on the edge of a large, empty, white-tiled swimming pool. The subject holds a vibrant pink electric guitar horizontally. The scene is framed by lush green tropical foliage and a tan wall, with a punk-rock, DIY aesthetic characterized by high-contrast lighting and raw, hand-drawn typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically against the stark white of the empty pool
Vibrant pink guitar acting as the primary color pop against a neutral palette
Rough, black hand-lettered text balanced against the subject on the left side
Grid-like blue tiles on the pool edge providing a geometric frame
coreInvariants: Empty white swimming pool with blue tile trim
Subject in black streetwear with blonde hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, standing on the mid-ground pool ledge, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The hot pink guitar held at waist level.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down to the pink guitar, follows the guitar neck to the right, then swings left to the large block of text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the white interior of the empty pool basin.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and off-white (pool interior) providing a clean, high-key background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (clothing and text) providing sharp definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot pink (guitar) serving as the focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the guitar vs. desaturated, natural tones in the background greenery and walls.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Irregular, blocky sans-serif with varying weights.
letterConstructionRules: Scratchy, hand-drawn strokes with visible ink bleed
Incorporation of symbols (like circled 'A') into letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'O' and 'A' are filled or replaced with punk symbols
Stems of letters have jagged, frayed ends

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the white pool wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom style; no secondary typeface needed.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn scribbles on the guitar body
Distressed leather jacket placed on the foreground ledge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the DIY punk aesthetic of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of a man with blonde hair standing on the edge of an empty white swimming pool with blue tiles. He is wearing a black t-shirt over a long-sleeved cream shirt and black jeans. He holds a bright pink electric guitar. Lush green trees are in the background behind a tan wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, black, hand-drawn scratchy text in a three-line stack on the left side of the image, positioned over the white pool wall. The text should look like it was drawn with a thick permanent marker.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar a vibrant, saturated pink?
Is the pool interior stark white?
Is the text scratchy and hand-drawn in appearance?
Is the subject standing on the blue-tiled ledge?

adjustableVariables: Guitar color (could be neon green or yellow)
Density of the foliage in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos on the guitar or clothing
Specific wording of the original text

mustAchieve: High contrast between the white pool and black elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject
Check that the guitar looks like a physical object in the scene
Verify the blue tile grid is consistent along the pool edge
Confirm the lighting is bright and slightly harsh
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key architectural void (empty pool) with a high-saturation prop (pink guitar) and low-fidelity graphic overlays (marker text) to create a modern alternative rock visual identity.
